استقتلوا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْتَلُوا (istaqtalū) /is.taq.ta.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَقْتَلَ (istaqtala)
# اِسْتَقْتِلُوا (istaqtilū) /is.taq.ti.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْتَلَ (istaqtala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
